The dual push signals that the Chinese AI model developer is accelerating both product iteration and capital-market plans. No technical details, pricing or IPO timetable have been disclosed yet.
items.why_zh: 若IPO落地，DeepSeek将成为又一家对接国内资本市场的头部大模型公司，其模型发布节奏与上市进程都值得关注。
items.why_en: If the IPO proceeds, DeepSeek would become another leading large-model company tapping China's domestic capital markets, making both its release cadence and listing progress closely watched.

items.title_zh: 中国软件协会吕卫锋回应“AI 替代程序员”：高度重视，支持从业人员向高附加值岗位转型
items.title_en: China Software Industry Association's Lü Weifeng on "AI Replacing Programmers": We Take It Seriously, Back a Shift to Higher-Value Roles
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 11 日消息，工信部今日召开《“人工智能 + 软件”专项行动实施方案》新闻发布会，有记者提到智能编程普及让一些软件从业人员感到压力，社会上也有“人工智能会替代程序员”的讨论。 中国软件行业协会副理事长兼秘书长吕卫锋表示， 当前这个问题社会关注度很高，我们也高度重视 。需要看到，人工智能推动软件生产方式变革，软件人才能力结构与岗位需求随之调整。 吕卫锋表示，从人才能力结构看： 一是单纯的编码执行能力权重下降 ，而需求理解、架构设计、系统集成、质量和安全控制等能力要求上升。这些环节对经验积累的依赖没有减弱，要求反而更高。 二是人机协同成为新的基础能力 ，准确表达开发意图、评估校验生成结果、编排多智能体协作，正在成为从业人员的必备技能。 三是复合型要求明显提高 ，既懂软件，又懂行业知识的人才更为紧缺。近来行业内出现前线部署工程师（FDE）等新角色，深入客户业务现场完成产品和服务的适配交付，对技术能力和行业理解都提出了较高要求。 从岗位结构看： 一方面， 存量岗位面临重构 ，重复性的编码工作逐步由智能编程工具承担，岗位职责向上游的需求和架构、下游的集成和运营延伸。 另一方面， 增量岗位持续涌现 ，人社部已将生成式人工智能系统应用员等纳入国家职业分类大典，增设了工业软件设计员、生成式人工智能系统测试员等新工种，围绕智能体开发、技能包和知识图谱建设、模型运营等方向的新岗位也在…
items.summary_en: At a MIIT press conference on the "AI + Software" action plan, China Software Industry Association vice chairman and secretary-general Lü Weifeng addressed fears that AI will replace programmers. He said pure coding is losing weight while requirements understanding, architecture, integration, and quality and safety control matter more, with human-AI collaboration becoming a baseline skill. Existing roles will be restructured while new ones—such as generative AI system operators and testers—enter the national occupation list.
items.why_zh: 行业协会在官方发布会上正面回应“AI替代程序员”，为软件从业者的能力转型方向提供了权威信号。
items.why_en: An industry association's official response signals both policy direction and the skills shift expected of software workers.

items.title_zh: 奥尔特曼称 OpenAI 考虑放缓前沿 AI 开发，希望其他公司也能跟进
items.title_en: Altman Says OpenAI May Slow Frontier AI Development, Hopes Others Follow
items.summary_zh: 北京时间 9 月 11 日，据彭博社报道，OpenAI 正在考虑放缓尖端 AI 的开发速度，该公司 CEO 萨姆 · 奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 希望其他 AI 公司也能采取同样的做法。 据多名知情人士透露，奥尔特曼本周在一次全体员工会议上告诉员工，OpenAI 可能会放慢 AI 开发节奏，或许会与其他几家 AI 实验室协同行动，但也有一些公司可能不会同意这么做。 近几周，头部 AI 公司的员工纷纷公开表达对先进 AI 系统风险上升的担忧，加剧了这些公司内部的焦虑。今年早些时候，OpenAI 及其竞争对手 Anthropic 都已秘密提交上市文件。 OpenAI 首席科学家雅库布 · 帕乔基 (Jakub Pachocki) 最近发表文章，警告 AI 带来的危险，认为 AI 公司应该“在必要时协调行动，放缓未来的开发进程”。帕乔基还表示，他希望“在共同的安全标准建立之前，自愿放缓开发能够成为行业惯例”。 OpenAI 已表示，出于安全方面的担忧，公司近期已经放缓了部分模型的开发，并暂停了特定内部 AI 训练。奥尔特曼曾在 7 月表示，他已与白宫官员讨论了放缓 AI 开发的“必要性”问题。 周二，Anthropic AI 研究员雅各布 · 考克森 (Jacob Coxon) 辞职，并指控他的两家前雇主 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在竞相迈向超级智能 AI 的过程中“…
items.summary_en: According to Bloomberg, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman told staff this week that the company may slow its AI development pace, possibly in coordination with other AI labs, though some firms may not agree. Chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has warned of AI risks and called for coordinated slowdowns. OpenAI says it has already slowed some model work and paused certain internal training for safety reasons.
items.why_zh: 头部实验室公开讨论主动放缓前沿模型开发，是AI安全治理与行业竞争之间张力的关键信号。
items.why_en: Leading labs openly weighing a deliberate slowdown is a key signal of the tension between AI safety governance and competition.

items.title_zh: OpenDiscoveryTrace：用过程轨迹评估 AI 科学家工作流
items.title_en: OpenDiscoveryTrace: Process Traces for Evaluating AI Scientist Workflows
items.summary_zh: 现有面向自主 AI 科学家的基准只评估最终产出——生成的代码、假设或论文，却丢弃了得到这些产出的推理过程，导致无法审计科学方法论、诊断失败模式，也难以区分系统性推理与侥幸猜测。为此，作者提出 OpenDiscoveryTrace，一个包含 558 条完整 AI 科学智能体轨迹的公开数据集，记录模型“如何推理”而不只是“产出什么”。每条轨迹以结构化方式逐步记录多个字段（摘要中提及每步为 9 字段结构），为过程级评估提供基础数据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing benchmarks for autonomous AI scientists evaluate only final outputs---generated code, hypotheses, or papers---yet discard the reasoning process by which those outputs were obtained. This makes it impossible to audit scientific methodology, diagnose failure modes, or distinguish systematic reasoning from fortunate guessing. We present \textbf{OpenDiscoveryTrace}, a public dataset of 558 complete AI scientific agent trajectories that captures how models reason, not just what they produce. Each trajectory records a structured 9-field-per-st…
items.why_zh: 它把 AI 科学家的评估从“看结果”推进到“看过程”，为审计科研方法论和诊断失败模式提供了公开数据基础。
items.why_en: It shifts evaluation of AI scientists from outcomes to process, offering public data for auditing methodology and diagnosing failure modes.

items.title_zh: 面向规模化关键材料回收的决策导向主动学习
items.title_en: Decision-Focused Active Learning for Scale-Aware Critical-Materials Recovery
items.summary_zh: 关键材料回收工艺的放大选择，需要把实验室结果与产品要求、工艺成本和规模效应联系起来。作者分析了太平洋西北国家实验室（PNNL）CICERO 工作流中自主选择性沉淀的记录，该工作流用主动学习依据既有结果选择下一步实验。在一个使用拟合模型和回收钕铁硼（NdFeB）磁体记录的“条件式回溯基准”中，主动学习能够找到记录中最优的结果，说明其可为放大决策提供支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Choosing a recovery process for scale-up requires connecting laboratory results with product requirements, process costs, and scale effects. We analyze records from Pacific Northwest National Laboratory's Computer Intelligence for Critical Element Recovery and Optimization (CICERO) workflow for autonomous selective precipitation. Active learning uses prior results to choose experiments. In a conditional retrospective benchmark with fitted models and recycled neodymium-iron-boron (NdFeB) magnet records, active learning finds the best recorded resu…
items.why_zh: 它展示了主动学习如何把实验数据转化为规模化工艺决策，对关键材料回收与自主实验平台具有实际价值。
items.why_en: It shows how active learning can turn experimental data into scale-up process decisions, valuable for critical-materials recovery and autonomous labs.

items.title_zh: 智能体知道自己成功了吗？从内部表征校准智能体置信度
items.title_en: Do Agents Know When They Succeed? Calibrating Agent Confidence from Internal Representations
items.summary_zh: 随着智能体系统在安全关键场景中快速落地，衡量其动作的置信度变得至关重要：相比传统机器学习系统，智能体工作流在规划、工具调用和动态环境交互上具有更复杂的失败模式。本文研究模型内部表征是否能为多轮智能体任务的最终成功提供更强信号，并提出两种互补方法，其中一种是“潜在轨迹动力学”（Latent Trajectory Dynamics, LTD）。研究指向利用内部表征来校准智能体对任务成功与否的自我判断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09448v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As agentic systems getting adopted rapidly in safety critical applications, it is vital to measure the confidence associated with the agentic actions. In comparison to the traditional machine learning systems, agentic workflows have complex failure modes with planning, tool invocation and dynamic environment interactions. In this paper, we investigate whether model's internal representations provide stronger signals of eventual task success in multi-turn agentic setups. We introduce two complementary methods: Latent Trajectory Dynamics (LTD), whi…
items.why_zh: 让智能体更可靠地判断自己是否成功，是安全关键场景中部署自主智能体的前提能力。
items.why_en: Reliable self-assessment of success is a prerequisite for deploying autonomous agents in safety-critical settings.

items.title_zh: CityPlanner：可执行城市规划的沙盒智能体
items.title_en: CityPlanner: A Sandbox Agent for Executable Urban Planning
items.summary_zh: 城市规划是一个真实世界的空间优化问题，需要在成本、服务质量等实际目标下，从庞大的候选空间中挑选可行行动。现有优化与强化学习方法在固定建模下有效，但往往依赖特定任务的表征和约束处理方式。作者提出 CityPlanner，一个用于可执行城市规划的沙盒智能体框架，并引入 UrbanSandbox——一个统一的、基于文件的环境，供智能体检查任务并在其中执行规划操作。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09578v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Urban planning is a real-world spatial optimization problem that requires selecting feasible actions from large candidate spaces under practical objectives such as cost and service quality. Existing optimization and reinforcement learning methods are effective for fixed formulations, but often depend on task-specific representations and constraint handling. We propose \emph{CityPlanner}, a sandbox-agent framework for executable urban planning. CityPlanner introduces \emph{UrbanSandbox}, a unified file-based environment where agents inspect task f…
items.why_zh: 它把城市规划从固定形式的优化问题转变为智能体可在统一沙盒中操作并执行的任务，降低了任务特定表征的依赖。
items.why_en: It reframes urban planning as an executable task for agents in a unified sandbox, reducing reliance on task-specific representations.

items.title_zh: 从状态同步到认知自演化：认知数字孪生的运行架构
items.title_en: From State Synchronization to Cognitive Self-Evolution: An Operational Architecture for Cognitive Digital Twins
items.summary_zh: 随着数字孪生（DT）系统从状态同步走向任务导向与知识驱动，认知数字孪生（CDT）作为在孪生运行中引入认知能力的扩展而出现。然而已有 CDT 研究多聚焦于具体使能技术，如学习模块、知识图谱和大语言模型，对如何将认知系统性整合进 DT 架构缺乏整体说明。为此，本文提出一个四层 CDT 架构，为认知能力在数字孪生中的组织与运行提供框架性方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09625v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As Digital Twin (DT) systems evolve beyond state synchronization toward task-oriented and knowledge-driven operation, Cognitive Digital Twins (CDTs) have emerged as an extension that incorporates cognitive capabilities into twin operation. Existing CDT studies often focus on specific enabling techniques, such as learning modules, knowledge graphs, and large language models, while providing limited insight into how cognition can be systematically integrated into DT architectures. To address this issue, this paper proposes a four-layer CDT architec…
items.why_zh: 它试图回答认知能力如何系统性地嵌入数字孪生架构这一整体设计问题，而不只是堆叠单项技术。
items.why_en: It addresses the architectural question of how cognition should be systematically embedded in digital twins, rather than merely stacking enabling techniques.

items.title_zh: 情感感知 AI 如何助力医疗与心理健康：通过网络欺凌早期检测
items.title_en: Can Artificial Intelligence Support Healthcare and Mental Health Through Early Cyberbullying Detection ? The Impact of Emotion-Aware AI on Proactive Online Safety
items.summary_zh: 医疗系统、心理健康与公共福祉日益受到网络欺凌和有害在线互动的影响。本文提出 CareGuard，一个早期预警框架，旨在通过先进自然语言处理技术检测与网络欺凌相关的内容，从而支持以医疗为导向的心理健康保护和主动的在线安全。CareGuard 将零样本语义标注与经过微调的 Transformer 模型（包括 BERT、DistilBERT 和 RoBERTa）相结合，以实现稳健且具备上下文感知的检测能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Healthcare systems, mental health, and public well-being are increasingly affected by cyberbullying and harmful online interactions. This paper presents CareGuard, an early-warning framework designed to support healthcare-driven mental health protection and proactive online safety through the detection of cyberbullying-related content using advanced natural language processing techniques. CareGuard integrates zero-shot semantic labeling with fine-tuned transformer-based models, including BERT, DistilBERT, and RoBERTa, to enable robust and context…
items.why_zh: 它把网络欺凌检测定位为心理健康防护的早期预警手段，展示了 NLP 在医疗与公共安全交叉领域的应用潜力。
items.why_en: It frames cyberbullying detection as early-warning mental-health protection, showing NLP's potential at the intersection of healthcare and online safety.

items.title_zh: LexAgentHallu：剖析法律智能体幻觉的分层基准
items.title_en: LexAgentHallu: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Profiling Hallucinations in Legal Agents
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型越来越多地被部署为工具增强的法律智能体，出现了“智能体幻觉”：工具调用与推理错误层层累积，最终导致编造的判例与错误的法源引用。然而现有法律基准只评估单轮问答并采用结果层面的指标，而智能体幻觉基准又缺乏法律领域的诊断能力，二者都无法回答法律智能体在轨迹中“幻觉到什么程度、以何种方式幻觉”。为弥补这一空白，作者提出 LexAgentHallu，一个面向法律智能体的分层基准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09754v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-augmented legal agents, they introduce agentic hallucinations where tool-call and reasoning errors cascade into fabricated holdings and miscited authority. However, existing legal benchmarks evaluate only single-turn QA with outcome-level metrics, while agentic hallucination benchmarks lack legal-specific diagnostic capability. Neither answers to what extent and how a legal agent hallucinates along its trajectory. To address these limitations, we introduce LexAgentHallu, a legal agentic h…
items.why_zh: 它填补了法律智能体幻觉缺乏过程级、领域化诊断的空白，有助于评估高风险法律场景中的可靠性。
items.why_en: It fills the gap in process-level, domain-specific diagnosis of legal agent hallucinations, aiding reliability assessment in high-stakes legal settings.

items.title_zh: Era by Eon 基准：带精确标准答案的生成式企业环境
items.title_en: The Era by Eon Benchmark: A Generated Enterprise Estate with Exact Ground Truth for Benchmarking LLM Agents
items.summary_zh: 面向企业记录系统的 LLM 智能体无法用客户生产数据进行评估，而现有替代方案又都不提供标准答案。为此作者提出 Era by Eon Benchmark，用于评估使用企业工具的 LLM 智能体。该基准围绕一家完整的虚构公司构建，包含产品模拟器、公司专属内部数据库、基准问题和计算得出的答案键。行业、公司规模、商业模式、应用组合和随机种子共同定义每家公司，并由一个带种子的实体图提供共享的公司数据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09853v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents for enterprise systems of record cannot be evaluated on customer production data, and no existing substitute provides ground truth. We present the Era by Eon Benchmark for evaluating LLM agents that use enterprise tools. The benchmark is built around a complete fictional company. It includes product simulators, company-specific internal databases, benchmark questions, and computed answer keys. Industry, company size, business model, application portfolio, and a seed define each company. One seeded entity graph supplies shared company d…
items.why_zh: 它用可生成、可复现且带精确答案键的虚构企业环境，解决了企业级 LLM 智能体无法在真实生产数据上评测的难题。
items.why_en: It offers a generated, reproducible fictional enterprise with exact answer keys, solving the problem that enterprise LLM agents cannot be evaluated on real production data.

items.title_zh: 行为语言模型中打分式与生成式读出的对比：引出格式的实证研究
items.title_en: Scored vs. Generated Readouts in Behavioral Language Models: An Empirical Study of Elicitation Format
items.summary_zh: 该研究关注在客户行为数据上微调的语言模型所给出的两类“读出”：直接对答案 token 打分得到的概率，与先写出理由再生成预测的结果。作者在固定模型检查点和提示内容的条件下，对覆盖三个市场、四类零售任务的 13 个“模型—领域”单元进行比较，其中两个单元使用完全公开的数据与检查点。结果显示，打分式读出在 13 个单元中的 12 个里对结果的排序更准确（双侧符号检验）。这说明两类读出并不能简单互换，评估与部署时需要区分其适用场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09882v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models fine-tuned on customer behavior can predict outcomes and generate explanations, but these readouts are often treated as interchangeable. Holding model checkpoint and prompt content fixed, we compare probabilities obtained by scoring answer tokens with predictions generated after a written rationale. Across 13 model-domain cells covering four retail tasks in three markets, including two using fully public data and checkpoints, the scored readout ranks outcomes more accurately in 12 of 13 cells (two-sided sign test, p approximately…
items.why_zh: 它表明语言模型的“打分”与“生成”两种读出并不等价，直接影响行为预测与模型评估方式的选择。
items.why_en: It shows that scored and generated readouts from language models are not interchangeable, directly affecting how behavioral predictions are evaluated and deployed.

items.title_zh: 面向无人机搭载 RIS 辅助动态 D2D 通信的 Decision Transformer
items.title_en: Decision Transformer for UAV-Mounted RIS-Assisted Dynamic D2D Communications
items.summary_zh: 论文研究无人机搭载可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助的设备到设备（D2D）通信，并考虑链路的随机激活。作者对无人机运动与姿态、时变莱斯角度以及依赖角度的 RIS 反射进行建模，在移动性、能量与硬件约束下，将无人机轨迹、姿态与 RIS 相位联合优化，以最大化平均和速率。求解上采用深度强化学习以及基于专家轨迹训练的 Decision Transformer。该工作把新兴的序列决策模型引入空天地协同通信的资源优化问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09885v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper studies unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-mouted reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted device-to-device (D2D) communication with stochastic link activation. It models UAV motion and attitude, time-varying Rician angles, and angle-dependent RIS reflection. A joint optimization of UAV trajectory, attitude, and RIS phases is formulated to maximize average sum rate under mobility, energy, and hardware constraints. The problem is addressed using deep reinforcement learning and a Decision Transformer trained on expert trajectories fr…
items.why_zh: 它展示了 Decision Transformer 在无人机—RIS 联合通信优化中的应用，为高动态无线网络的资源调度提供了新思路。
items.why_en: It demonstrates Decision Transformer applied to joint UAV-RIS communication optimization, offering a new approach to resource scheduling in highly dynamic wireless networks.

items.title_zh: 面向自然语言到 PDDL 问题生成的落地式评估与修复
items.title_en: Grounded Evaluation and Repair for NL-to-PDDL Problem Generation
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型被用于把自然语言规划描述转写为 PDDL 问题实例，但论文指出，语法有效性或规划器求解成功等常规评估标准会显著高估生成结果对原任务的忠实度：生成的问题可能可解析、可求解，却错误表达了初始状态、目标、对象结构或优化目标。为此，作者研究了一条端到端的 NL-to-PDDL 流水线，结合 LLM 生成与 PDDL 解析等检查，并加入修复环节。该工作提示，规划领域需要更贴近语义的评估方式，而非仅看可解性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09898v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for translating Natural Language (NL) planning descriptions into PDDL problem instances. However, standard evaluation criteria such as syntactic validity or planner success can substantially overestimate faithfulness to the described task: a generated problem may be parseable and solvable while misrepresenting the intended initial state, goal, object structure, or optimization target. This paper studies an end-to-end NL-to-PDDL pipeline that combines LLM generation, checks in terms of PDDL parsing,…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了当前 NL-to-PDDL 评估指标的失真风险，并给出评估加修复的可行路径。
items.why_en: It exposes how current NL-to-PDDL evaluation metrics can be misleading and offers a combined evaluation-and-repair pipeline.

items.title_zh: OntologyAligner：本体对齐检索与层级引导重排序的生物医学本体规范化框架
items.title_en: OntologyAligner: Ontology-Aligned Retrieval and Hierarchy-Guided Large Language Model Reranking for Biomedical Ontology Normalization
items.summary_zh: 生物医学本体规范化要把自由文本表达映射到标准概念，但词汇多样性和层级相关概念之间的细微差异会模糊概念边界，使该任务依然困难。作者提出 OntologyAligner，一个三阶段框架：本体对齐检索、大语言模型候选重排序，以及选择性的层级引导精化。团队同时构建了 PhenoNormBench 统一基准，包含 13,390 条（数据条目，摘要此处截断）。该工作结合检索、LLM 与本体层级结构，为生物医学数据的统一整合与分析提供支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10055v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Biomedical ontology normalization maps free-text expressions to standardized concepts, enabling consistent integration and analysis of biomedical data. This task remains challenging because lexical variation and subtle distinctions among hierarchically related concepts can obscure concept boundaries. We present OntologyAligner, a three-stage framework that combines ontology-aligned retrieval, large language model candidate reranking, and selective hierarchy-guided refinement. We also construct PhenoNormBench, a unified benchmark comprising 13,390…
items.why_zh: 它为生物医学本体规范化提供了检索、LLM 重排序与层级结构相结合的方案和统一评测基准。
items.why_en: It offers a combined retrieval, LLM reranking, and hierarchy-guided approach plus a unified benchmark for biomedical ontology normalization.

items.title_zh: 基于隐藏状态相对表示的参考式大模型偏见检测
items.title_en: Reference-Based Bias Detection in LLMs via Relative Representations of Hidden States
items.summary_zh: 现有偏见审计方法通常依赖模型输出，需要昂贵基准或评判模型，并可能遗漏那些从未出现在生成文本中的内部变化。作者提出一种参考式方法，在相关模型变体（例如微调前后）之间审计隐藏状态表示中的偏见。由于微调会重塑表示几何结构，绝对隐藏状态无法直接比较，因此该方法用每个句子与一组固定锚点句的相似度来编码句子，得到相对表示。这为在输出之外、从内部表征层面检测偏见提供了新途径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing bias auditing methods typically rely on model outputs, requiring costly benchmarks or judge models and potentially missing internal shifts that never appear in generated text. We propose a reference-based method that audits bias in hidden-state representations across related model variants, for example before and after fine-tuning. Because fine-tuning reshapes representation geometry, absolute hidden states are not directly comparable, so we encode each sentence by its similarities to a fixed set of anchor sentences, yielding relative re…
items.why_zh: 它把偏见审计从输出层推进到内部表示层，可发现生成文本中未曾显现的偏见变化。
items.why_en: It moves bias auditing from outputs to internal representations, catching bias shifts that never appear in generated text.

items.title_zh: 面向高原天气预警的智能体式 ML-LLM 融合与自优化提示
items.title_en: Agent-Based ML-LLM Fusion with Self-Optimizing Prompts for Plateau Weather Alerts
items.summary_zh: 针对旅游气象服务中上下文不足、泛化能力弱、场景适应性差的问题，作者提出 SmartWeatherAgent，一个统一的三阶段架构，涵盖意图识别、灾害预测与推理增强生成。系统将规则方法与大型语言模型融合，以多粒度解析查询，并采用加入高原特有特征（如风速突变率）的 LightGBM 模型，取得 F1-Macro 0.605、延迟 1.60 毫秒的表现（摘要此处截断）。该工作展示了机器学习与 LLM 智能体结合在垂直气象服务中的落地潜力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To address insufficient contextualization, weak generalization, and poor scenario adaptation in tourism meteorological services, we propose SmartWeatherAgent--a unified three-stage architecture integrating intent recognition, hazard prediction, and reasoning-enhanced generation. The system fuses rule-based methods with large language models to parse queries at multiple granularities and employs a LightGBM model enriched with highland-specific features (e.g., wind speed abruptness rate), achieving an F1-Macro score of 0.605 with 1.60 ms latency on…
items.why_zh: 它给出了 ML 与 LLM 智能体融合、面向高原旅游气象预警的可落地架构与量化效果。
items.why_en: It presents a deployable ML-LLM agent architecture with measured results for plateau tourism weather alerting.
